name: Baillieu wines at Merricks Store
signature: Merricks General Wine Store is the public cellar door for Baillieu wines. The vineyard itself is not open to visitors.
editorNote:
Merricks General Wine Store is the public cellar door for Baillieu wines. The vineyard itself is not open to visitors.

The Store lists cellar door tastings and sales from 10 am to 5 pm daily. The Store offers complimentary tastings for individuals. Groups of up to six need an appointment and usually pay a tasting fee. Bistro reservations are separate.
whyWeGo: Taste Baillieu and Elgee Park wines at one stop in Merricks, with the option to book lunch separately.
ifOnlyOneThing: Go to Merricks Store for the tasting, not the vineyard. Contact the Store in advance for a group.
